description: This is a vintage, carved wooden stool with three legs. The seat is roughly circular and features an intricate criss-cross pattern with parallel lines carved into the surface, bordered by a decorative scalloped edge. The three legs are tapered and also show signs of carving and wear. The wood has a rich, dark brown color with a visible grain, suggesting it is aged and has been well-used. The stool appears sturdy and functional, likely used as seating or a small surface. The overall aesthetic suggests an ethnic or tribal influence, common in handcrafted furniture from certain regions.
